scenes.text: An older person pours you a drink in Korea. What do you do? Answer before the timer ends.
scenes.q: An elder pours you a drink. You…
scenes.a: Hold the glass with two hands

scenes.text: Hold your glass with two hands. It's a sign of respect. When you drink, many people turn their head slightly away.
scenes.why: Two hands on the glass. It shows respect.

caption:
An older person pours you a drink in Korea. What do you do? 🍶
Hold your glass with two hands: it's a sign of respect. Many people also turn their head slightly away to drink.
